findings: Original SNL128 identifies the plain U.S. Standard hexagon half-inch nut and explicitly lists the half-inch by one-inch bolt among its uses. The518 row quantity covers many joints; it is not the cap allocation.
Original SNL270 identifies the half-inch lock washer and explicitly lists the half-inch by one-inch bolt among its uses. This row continues beyond the page; no total is inferred.
Fourteen bolt/nut/lockwasher sets for the two casing caps are taken from the separate inspected SNL31:002 allocation. Each set is decomposed into three independently identified physical leaves.

Across-flats sizes, head/nut/washer thicknesses and exact washer form are reconstruction assumptions. Thread mating uses cylindrical envelopes; no thread engagement or spring/load performance qualification is claimed.
